ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** take a photo from the recording bar and from Navigate's ready screen, so its editor opens by itself (decision 0240), then press Android Back with and without changes. **Expect:** the editor opens as its own Modal from both; Back goes through `requestClose`: with changes it asks "Discard these edits?", without it closes and the photo is kept as taken. (ME2, ME23)

- [ ] **Do:** on iOS and Android, take a photo and then a video with the system camera from the walk screen, Navigate's ready screen, the minimized walk's recording bar (on Explore) and Memories' toolbar; tap Use Photo (iOS) or the tick (Android) each time. **Expect:** the media editor opens by itself as the camera closes, on Crop, as a Modal of its own (on iOS presenting it while the picker is still being dismissed can be refused or leave nothing on screen), with the moment stored underneath; Close with no change keeps it as taken and its pin then shows on the map; Done saves the edit and the pin shows the edited copy; Android Back goes through the editor's Close. Never run on a phone (fix edit-after-capture, decision 0240).
